title: IRIS internal outbox event
description: A row in `event_outbox`. INTERNAL — not part of the integration contract and may change without a version bump. Written in the SAME transaction as the state change it describes: never enqueue after COMMIT, because a lost access.revoke means access outlives its ticket, silently.

aggregate.description: Which entity kind the event concerns.

request_id.description: Correlates the whole cross-service trace, and is stamped onto audit_event.

published_at.description: Null until a consumer drains it. Delivery is at-least-once, so consumers must be idempotent on event_id.
